move.text:

As a distributor, we do not provide detailed cost breakdowns, but our pricing reflects current market rates and our reliable service. Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Furthermore, our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. 

To offer a more competitive price, we would need a commitment to higher volumes or a longer contract term. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
